name: The Watering Hole — Lake Superior
description: Where all primals meet. Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore, Lake Superior — the shared knowledge layer of ecoPrimals anchored to the largest freshwater lake on Earth. 20,900 sq mi of fresh water. 10% of the world's surface freshwater. 1,332 ft deep. The meeting place.

metadata.concept: The Watering Hole is the shared knowledge layer of ecoPrimals. Every primal comes here to drink — to understand the ecosystem it belongs to. Anchored at Lake Superior, the largest freshwater body on Earth, because freshwater IS the meeting place. All rivers flow to the lake. All primals flow to the watering hole.
